words: 0.4.2 adds one optional column, market_value_eod_claim (measured or inferred), required on every PRESENT Orion row and null on an ABSENT row; the contract's optional_columns gains that sixth entry and the enums block gains its enum. The 19 columns, their types, schema_hash, every earlier enum and the five earlier optional columns are byte-identical; served_day_rules, source_requires and source_rules are unmoved, and rule24_record keeps every earlier key and adds v042. A Black Diamond row validates with or without the claim, and the 0.4.2 test file (22 tests) passes. NOT all earlier tests pass: twelve tests of the 0.4.1 file build Orion rows without the claim, which 0.4.2 now requires on a PRESENT row and its 0.4.1 validator does not exempt on an ABSENT row; they are surfaced, not repaired, so an Orion row written without the claim does not validate under 0.4.2. NOT PROVEN: that the Scope adapter writes the claim as the contract declares it, that its parquet output validates against this contract, or that any consumer rejects an inferred value.
